the demonstration that human peripheral blood B cells are functionally activated in response to polyclonal T cell mitogens and that the B cell activation is dependent on T cell participation in the culture.
the in vitro induction and characterization of human polyclonal B lymphocyte activation by polyclonal T cell mitogens.
the demonstration of the ability of polyclonal T cell activators to induce the functional activation of the B cell in vitro.
